{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Worker where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64
import Data.Word (Word64, Word32)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftR, shiftL, (.&.))
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX (getPOSIXTime)
import Control.Monad (forM_, replicateM)
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import qualified Crypto.Cipher.AES as AES
import qualified Crypto.Cipher.Types as CT
import qualified Crypto.Error as CE
import qualified Crypto.Random as CR
import qualified Crypto.Hash as H
import qualified Crypto.MAC.HMAC as HMAC
import qualified Data.ByteArray as BA

-- | Cryptographically secure random byte generation
-- Uses OS entropy source via cryptonite's DRG
{-# NOINLINE csprgRef #-}
csprgRef :: IORef CR.ChaChaDRG
csprgRef = unsafePerformIO $ do
  drg <- CR.drgNew
  newIORef drg

-- | Generate n cryptographically secure random bytes
generateBytes :: Int -> IO BS.ByteString
generateBytes n = do
  drg <- readIORef csprgRef
  let (bytes, drg') = CR.randomBytesGenerate n drg
  writeIORef csprgRef drg'
  return $ BA.convert bytes

word64ToBS :: Word64 -> BS.ByteString
word64ToBS w = BS.pack
  [ fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 56)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 48)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 40)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 32)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 24)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 16)
  , fromIntegral (w `shiftR` 8)
  , fromIntegral w
  ]

-- | Derive a per-job encryption key using CSPRNG
deriveJobKey :: BS.ByteString -> IO BS.ByteString
deriveJobKey jobId = do
  -- Generate 32 cryptographically secure bytes for AES-256
  randomMaterial <- generateBytes 32
  -- XOR with job ID hash for domain separation
  let idHash = simpleHash jobId
      key = BS.pack $ zipWith xor (BS.unpack randomMaterial) (cycle $ BS.unpack idHash)
  return key

-- | Simple non-cryptographic hash (used only for domain separation)
simpleHash :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
simpleHash bs =
  let h = BS.foldl' (\acc b -> acc * 31 + fromIntegral b) (5381 :: Word64) bs
  in word64ToBS h

-- | Derive a separate MAC key from the encryption key using HMAC-SHA256
-- as a KDF, so the encryption key and MAC key are independent.
deriveMacKey :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
deriveMacKey encKey =
  let mac = HMAC.hmac encKey ("job-mac-key-v1" :: BS.ByteString) :: HMAC.HMAC H.SHA256
  in BA.convert (HMAC.hmacGetDigest mac)

-- | Compute an authentication tag over the ciphertext (Encrypt-then-MAC)
computeTag :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
computeTag macKey ciphertext =
  let mac = HMAC.hmac macKey ciphertext :: HMAC.HMAC H.SHA256
  in BA.convert (HMAC.hmacGetDigest mac)

-- | Encrypt job payload with derived key (AES-256-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 Encrypt-then-MAC)
encryptPayload :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO BS.ByteString
encryptPayload key plaintext = do
  iv <- generateBytes 16
  case CE.eitherCryptoError (AES.cipherInit (BS.take 32 key) :: CE.CryptoFailable AES.AES256) of
    Left err -> error $ "Cipher init failed: " ++ show err
    Right cipher -> do
      let padded = pkcs7Pad 16 plaintext
          encrypted = CT.cbcEncrypt cipher (CT.makeIV iv `orFail` "IV creation failed") padded
          body = iv <> encrypted
          macKey = deriveMacKey (BS.take 32 key)
          tag = computeTag macKey body
      -- Encrypt-then-MAC: authenticate IV + ciphertext, append tag
      return $ body <> tag

orFail :: Maybe a -> String -> a
orFail (Just x) _ = x
orFail Nothing msg = error msg

-- | PKCS7 padding
pkcs7Pad :: Int -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
pkcs7Pad blockSize bs =
  let padLen = blockSize - (BS.length bs `mod` blockSize)
      padding = BS.replicate padLen (fromIntegral padLen)
  in bs <> padding

-- | Job queue entry
data Job = Job
  { jobIdentifier :: BS.ByteString
  , jobPayload    :: BS.ByteString
  , jobPriority   :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Process a single job: encrypt its payload and store
processJob :: Job -> IO BS.ByteString
processJob job = do
  key <- deriveJobKey (jobIdentifier job)
  encrypted <- encryptPayload key (jobPayload job)
  -- In production, this would write to encrypted storage
  let stored = B64.encode encrypted
  return stored

-- | Worker loop that processes jobs from a shared queue
workerLoop :: MVar [Job] -> IO ()
workerLoop queueVar = do
  jobs <- takeMVar queueVar
  case jobs of
    [] -> do
      putMVar queueVar []
      threadDelay 100000
      workerLoop queueVar
    (j:rest) -> do
      putMVar queueVar rest
      _ <- processJob j
      workerLoop queueVar

-- | Initialize the worker pool
initWorkerPool :: Int -> MVar [Job] -> IO ()
initWorkerPool numWorkers queueVar =
  forM_ [1..numWorkers] $ \_ ->
    forkIO (workerLoop queueVar)

-- | Reseed from OS entropy (called periodically for forward secrecy)
reseedPool :: IO ()
reseedPool = do
  newDrg <- CR.drgNew
  writeIORef csprgRef newDrg
